text:
Geelani replaced Mirwaiz Umar Farooq as APHC chairman in 1998, according to Wikipedia's Geelani entry, which lists his tenure as 1998 to 20 July 2000. The team note's claim that the change came right after the 1996 state elections is not supported by these sources, so I'd disregard that detail. The sources also don't fully agree on the sequence of later chairmanships, so the 1998 date rests mainly on that one infobox.

Sources: [Syed Ali Shah Geelani (Wikipedia)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Syed_Ali_Shah_Geelani), [Mirwaiz Umar Farooq (Wikipedia)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mirwaiz_Umar_Farooq), [All Parties Hurriyat Conference (Wikipedia)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/All_Parties_Hurriyat_Conference)

CONFIDENCE: 70
